Additionally, a three-module feature row (center-bottom icons/text: 'EVENTO 100% ONLINE E AO VIVO', 'CONTEÚDO PRÁTICO E DIRETO AO PONTO', 'GARANTA SUA VAGA AGORA') and a top-left badge 'PREPARE-SE' create more than three similarly weighted information zones. The neon green glow, volumetric CTA pill and heavy glow on the door read as generic template tropes not clearly justified by the compliance training brief.
